title: Walk-in || Technical Sales Trainee - Finolex Cable Limited
description:
Time and Venue:
Interview Date: 14 Nov - 30 Nov
Timing: 9.30 AM - 5.30 PM
Venue: Pune
C 401
Contact: HR Prakash Rathod (9822482545)

Finolex Cable Limited 
 Program Details Program Name: Sales Trainee /Management Trainee (MT) Program (Off Roll for minimum 1 year and Full Time) Total Vacancies: 96 Qualification: Any graduates and B.E. in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering along with an MBA Experience: Freshers or candidates with up to 6 months of experience Target Candidates: Recent MBA graduates from the 2023 batch, preferably based in the cities where our branch offices are located Preferred Institutions: Tier 2 and Tier 3 management colleges 2. Key Roles and Responsibilities Selected candidates will gain practical exposure to sales, marketing, channel development, and customer relationship management. Their key responsibilities will include: Conducting market research and mapping potential business opportunities. Developing institutional customers, including builders, developers, and architects. Organizing promotional activities, seminars, customer meets, and exhibition participation. Appointing new channel partners and developing business through regular market visits. Coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely product deliveries. Training distributor sales personnel to improve market coverage. Monitoring distributor stock and ensuring adequate product availability. Preparing and submitting periodic MIS reports to the Branch Head. Addressing customer complaints and communicating feedback and suggestions to the Head Office. 3. Selection Process The proposed recruitment process will include: Coordination with the college placement cell for organizing a campus or offline recruitment drive. Initial screening and shortlisting by the HR team. Interviews and selection by the concerned Technical Head (TH) and President Marketing. Final management approval. Issuance of offer letters to selected candidates by the HR team. 4. Training and Career Progression Selected Management Trainees will undergo a structured one-year training program. A comprehensive induction program will be conducted at our Pune Head Office in the month following their joining. Upon successful completion of the training period, candidates may be absorbed on probation for six months, subject to performance and available vacancies. Confirmation will be considered upon successful completion of the probation period, based on performance. Candidates may be transferred to any location across India during or after the training period, depending on business requirements.

Key Skills: Marketing,Sales coordination,Technical sales,Training,Marketing support,Coordination,Sales,Sales operations

title: Relationship Officer Wheels
description:
1.*Business Development*: - Identify and pursue new business opportunities with dealerships,customers, and other stakeholders. - Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers. 2. *SalesGrowth*: - Meet and exceed sales targets for vehicle financing products. - Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve business objectives. 3.*Customer Relationship Management*: - Understand customer needs and provide tailored financial solutions. - Ensure customer satisfaction and retention. 4.*Dealership Partnership*: - Collaborate with dealerships to promote vehicle financing products. - Provide training and support to dealership staff. 5. *CreditAssessment*: - Conduct basic credit assessments and risk evaluations. - Ensure applications meet lending criteria. 6.*Documentation and Compliance*: - Ensure accurate and complete documentation for loan applications. - Comply with regulatory requirements and company policies.
